jale_api.workloads: The authenticated worker, employer and dual request Lambdas, and the Cognito post-confirmation trigger.
jale_api.reason: Dedicated request login; reviewed grants and policies replace ownership. No connection limit: it carries the request fleet.

jale_api_public.workloads: The unauthenticated worker sign-up, tokenized document upload and digest unsubscribe endpoints.
jale_api_public.reason: EXECUTE-only login with no table rights: each endpoint reaches the database through one or a few functions.

jale_job_email_sender.reason: Drains the transactional email outbox for both producers: SELECT and UPDATE on every row, no INSERT or DELETE.

jale_job_visibility_drain.reason: Drains job visibility events (no personal data): SELECT and UPDATE on every row, no INSERT or DELETE.

jale_job_digest.reason: Enumerates due employers through the digest definer, then reads each employer's own data under that employer's context and enqueues one email.

jale_job_ses_feedback.reason: EXECUTE on one capability function only.

jale_job_retention.reason: EXECUTE on one capability function only; the batched deletes run inside it.

jale_posture.reason: Catalog-only login: no table, function or schema rights beyond the defaults.

jale_whatsapp.workloads: The WhatsApp engine Lambdas, the web onboarding door and the worker application details door.
jale_whatsapp.reason: Service login that predates the dedicated least-privilege logins.

jale_ai.workloads: The AI generators, trust scorer and trust extractor.

jale_cap_hired_counts.reason: Owns the hired-count trigger function; reads application status and updates two job columns.

jale_cap_job_messaging.reason: Owns the job-messaging triggers: binds a conversation to its application, derives the recipient of a request-login outbox row.

jale_cap_retention.reason: Owns the referral retention purge; deletes only rows past their retention age.

jale_cap_ses_feedback.reason: Owns the delivery-feedback function: looks up one outbox row by provider message id.

jale_cap_share_links.reason: Owns the share-code lookup; reads one active link for a presented code.

jale_cap_stale_outbox.reason: Owns stale employer-message discovery; reads only stale outbox rows.

jale_cap_upload_tokens.reason: Owns the tokenized upload functions; the only role with rights on the upload-token tables.

jale_cap_worker_lane.reason: Owns the employer-to-worker delivery functions; explicit grants and policies on the worker-lane tables.

jale_ops_readonly.reason: Operator read-only group; holds no grants until the operator views are reviewed. Members must be time-limited personal logins.

jale_rls_relationship_reader.reason: Owns the jale_internal relationship predicates the request policies call.

jale_digest_enumerator.reason: Owns the jale_digest_internal enumeration and unsubscribe functions.

jale_billing_job_enforcer.reason: Owns the jale_billing_internal job-limit enforcement function.

jale_location_backfill.reason: Legacy geo backfill helper; holds read access to jobs and no memberships after 104.

rdsadmin.reason: The managed database service's administrative superuser. On the managed instance it is also the bootstrap superuser, which is accepted as such. Accepted only when present; unconfirmed until the first report-only posture run on the managed instance names the roles actually there.

rdsrepladmin.reason: The managed database service's internal replication administration role. Accepted only when present; unconfirmed until the first report-only posture run on the managed instance names the roles actually there.

rdstopmgr.reason: The managed database service's internal topology management role. Accepted only when present; unconfirmed until the first report-only posture run on the managed instance names the roles actually there.

jale_billing_internal.reason: Billing job-limit enforcement. Closed to PUBLIC; USAGE for the billing login.

jale_cap.reason: Capability functions. Closed to PUBLIC; callers get USAGE, owners CREATE (to own their functions).

jale_digest_internal.reason: Digest enumeration and unsubscribe functions. Closed to PUBLIC; USAGE for their callers.

jale_internal.reason: Relationship predicates the request policies call. Closed to PUBLIC; USAGE only for direct by-name callers.

jale_twilio_callback.reason: Delivery-status callback functions. Closed to PUBLIC; USAGE for the WhatsApp engine.
